steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Have you finished cleaning up the streets?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yes, General. Everyone on the list has already been dealt with.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Some tried to flee to other boroughs or leave the city just as you said, and we stopped them as well.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Only a few slipped through our net... The soldiers sent to chase after them seemingly ran into the same Sarkaz from Rhodes Island as yesterday.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Let them squirm their way underground.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: That'll make it easier for us to flush them all out at once.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: ...Multiple of our contact points above ground were attacked all at once?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: What of our Messengers? They got taken as well?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Doctor, I want to hear your view on this.

options: Rhodes Island wasn't told where these points were.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The only ones with access to that information are our own troops.

options: We were tailed on the way back yesterday.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It seems the seeds of crisis were sown last night.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: But I don't want to doubt our own soldiers.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: There's no way they'd betray their brothers and sisters.

options: The commander is responsible for the team.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Twelve people came back with Heidi.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Among them, nine only ever provided us information on occasion.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The other three helped us transport supplies, so it is possible they know the locations of some contact points.

options: How many more are in Sarkaz hands?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: ...A lot more.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Doctor, you know better than anyone how difficult last night's operation was. As much as I'd like to rescue everyone, I'm forced to admit that we're not yet strong enough.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Heidi's done good work. Being able to save all those people already went above and beyond my expectations.

options: The Sarkaz couldn't know who would be rescued.
You don't place a pawn that won't be used.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: There were a lot of uncertainties surrounding our operation last night...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I doubt the Sarkaz could have full control over everything.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: That's simply not possible.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The Sarkaz commander isn't a fool. He would have found a way to make sure his plan succeeded.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: So, if there really were traitors among the soldiers we saved...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: In all likelihood, they would've been the easiest for us to rescue.

options: The most obvious suspects are clear.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Still, I don't want to fling these accusations around about soldiers willing to bleed and die for their homeland.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: We need proof.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: How do you suppose we get that, Doctor?

options: Let's go visit the wounded together.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Why aren't you moving? The commander just sent news that Bill's about to wake up.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: ...Rockrock.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I want to tell her that I'm stepping down as captain of the operation team.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Take a look at these.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Packages? What's inside them?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Johnny and Gabby's belongings. I picked out the stuff to send back to their families.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: What remains are their tools, weapons, and equipment. If you really... can't get them out of your head, then pick out something useful and polish it up a bit. That way they'll at least still be with us on the battlefield.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sounds like the vice-captain rejected my resignation... Let's go see Bill then.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're awake?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Something came up, so Miss Heidi had to leave. She was originally the one in charge of coordinating the treatment of the wounded here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait, you're from Mr. Feist's team. Bill, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Bill, should I go call Feist and Rockrock over?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Ah, no, that's alright.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Miss Amiya, I decided to get up to talk to you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Well, uh... I've always been curious about you.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Amiya of Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Why do they trust you so much? You're just a Cautus in her teens.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you... talking about our operators?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've been through so much together. You're correct that they trust me, but that trust is mutual.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As far as I can tell, it's no different for everyone in the Self-Salvation Corps either. You also trust Feist, Rockrock, and Clovisia, right?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Haha... Mutual trust, huh? That might be a part of it. After all, you've been through your share of trials and tribulations.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: But your authority does not come from your bloodline, nor have you taken your position by force. You are far too young to have earned the amount of trust you enjoy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Mr. Bill?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Deep down, you've thought about these things too, haven't you? But you don't dare show it. Your fears, your worries, your anxiety... Everything is suppressed by the responsibilities they've forced onto you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you worried about me? Did you overhear my conversation with Miss Heidi?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Mm... Maybe. I heard everything.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I appreciate the concern, but my responsibilities were not forced onto me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our operators placed their faith in me, and I am not going to let them down.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Of course... Of course. Since the very beginning, they've always been devoted to you.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: But Amiya... When they look at you, how do you know that they're not looking right past you? Searching for another soul that has endured the twists and turns of fate?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Everything you believe, do you truly believe it, or...

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Are you dreaming a dream given to you by somebody else... one that you can't wake up from no matter how much you struggle?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Bill... No, that's not who you are!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Who exactly are you?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Allow me to return the question.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Amiya... Who are you?

a.text: Amiya, do you like the stories I tell? You'll still be able to sleep well, won't you? I don't want you to have nightmares.
You won't? Oh, what a sweet child you are.
That's right, while we may look different in many ways, we are both children given life and nurtured by this great land.
Some of the stories you've heard are legends that others find terrifying, but they are indeed the history of the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You shouldn't be here.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: I see the energy gathering inside your palm. Have you not figured out who I am? Why aren't you attacking?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I cannot touch your emotions, 'Mr. Bill'.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... I also cannot feel any malice.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You could have continued pretending to be asleep, yet you said all those things to me...

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Hah, didn't I already tell you? We are very curious about you.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: If not for you, we'd have no desire to come here either. Theresis has no sway over us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No matter what you're after... this is far too cruel.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Cruel...?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Do you mean this face we're borrowing?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, which is why I need you to leave.
Black lines surged from her palm once more, weaving a net around the man in the Self-Salvation Corps uniform.
One strand condensed into a lightless blade, pressed against his throat.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: What a... remarkably gentle threat.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Amiya, a lot of people have told you this before, yes?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: You really are just like her.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not another word out of you, please.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Unfortunately, you're still too immature.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Always be aware of your surroundings before you make a move.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: ...Miss Amiya?!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You, you... you're trying to kill Bill?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, I...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Doctor, I take it that you didn't ask me to bring everyone here just to see this scene?

options: I wanted to see who'd make the first move.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: I assume you're not referring to Amiya. Then, Bill?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Rockrock... Rockrock, help me...

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: I'd rather die myself... than betray you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Stay away from him. I... No, nobody knows the full extent of his Originium Arts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: His words are, or rather his very existence is... dangerous.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Miss Amiya... Can I trust you?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Last night, we fought side-by-side. I thought Rhodes Island truly had our backs, just as you said.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Your expression scares me. It's as if I've seen it somewhere before...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: That's right, you're already mourning the pain and suffering you're about to cause.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: If so, then... why? Why go through with it?!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: She... The Sarkaz took my father from me, right before my eyes. Are you going to take my family away too?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry, Miss Rockrock... But it's too late. Your family member's already gone.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But, Bill's right in front of us!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This must be difficult... for you to accept.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: ...I don't understand.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Look, Amiya, it's not that we're not willing to believe you, but we don't have your Arts. We can't see what you see.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Commander... I can see it.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Captain?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: He might not actually be the same Bill we know.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But those wounds on his body... he got all those from saving me yesterday!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You said it yourself, Rockrock. The Sarkaz are masters of disguise, but we can't let ourselves be fooled.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But how...?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Look, I brought along the Metal Crab I was going to give to Bill.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: See for yourself.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Ugh, when did this thing crawl onto me?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: He didn't even spare it a glance. The only thing in his eyes is Miss Amiya. He's so proud of having deceived us that he's long forgotten... about the bond between us.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: All because of this insignificant little machine?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Don't you think you're being a bit too hasty, Feist? Aren't we sworn blood brothers?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've made a lot of hasty decisions these last few days.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Bill, my good man... if he were still around, he'd be ruthlessly making fun of me. I miss him. I miss him so much.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Whoever you are... Don't make me pry that mask off your face with my wrench.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Rockrock, are you going to break my heart, just like him?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I'll never turn my back on my family.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But you... you're acting less and less like him.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: He would never talk like that. He would never try to manipulate us.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: ...So you really don't think I'm the real Bill? Feist, are you really okay with that?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: I'll have you know, if so, then that means your friend died in vain.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Anyone else may have the right to say that, but you sure as hell don't!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Haha. You're pretty smart, but unfortunately for you...

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: It's too late.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Artilleryman, are you ready?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yes, General. The cannon is aimed at the target.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Remember, we're leveling every single building except the train station and the tracks.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Increase the output to maximum.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: M-Maximum? That might blow right through to the structural levels—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Did you hear what the Confessarius's Messenger said? In their eyes, this whole tract of land, including the factories above, is worth nothing to us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Then... Then, what about our people underneath...?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hoederer will guard the safe areas under the city walls.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: But what about—

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Uhh... Who do you think is heading underground to deal with the rebels?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The Sanguinarch?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As long as you get it. If these toys can take HIM out, I'd be... extremely surprised.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As for the other one...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I've been curious for a while now. If it came to an all-out battle with the Prince, who would come out on top?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thank goodness you're all here—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Huh? Why does it feel like I walked right into a fight about to break out?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Anyway Doctor, I sent up some drones like you requested— They're really about to resume! Th-They're pointing those cannons right at us!

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Notify Heidi and Harmo. We're evacuating immediately.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hold on, I'm getting a strong Originium reading! They're aiming at our current location!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We've only got ten seconds!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Nine—

steps.name: Bill?
steps.text: —Why are you holding on to me?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You said it yourself, we're sworn blood brothers. I don't want to... pass judgment too hastily.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Captain... I don't think... I can carry the two of you...

steps.name: Bill?
steps.text: I'll admit that you people are very... interesting.

steps.name: Bill?
steps.text: Goodbye, Captain.

steps.name: Bill?
steps.text: Goodbye, Rockrock.

steps.name: Bill?
steps.text: Bill wanted you to live on. Those were his last words.
